descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S07 「行数：只有表头的页、一行、一张长名单」 Row counts: header-only page, one row, a long list

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 2；TFA-92580 How it works 2-3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 6；TFA-92580 How it works 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Lists with 0, 1 and many patient rows, plus header/footer text

When Each is read by scanCensusSheet in its mode

Then A header-only page returns no patient, so nothing is added. One row returns exactly that row. A 40-row census and a 30-row resident list return every patient exactly once. No column label or footer becomes a patient

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Returned row count equals truth (0/1/40/0/1/30). Every truth name appears once. No returned name equals a header word ('Patient', 'Room', 'Confidential'…). What the physician sees for the 0-row result is S26

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
